annotations.text: WK-2361 D10 acceptance.criteria[0] | ARCHITECTURE DRAFT D10, dispositioned once from the complete D9 all-accepted-decisions review at current main `dba2c0d0b140d35a805f6eece32bb63ad67b0899`. D7 and its review evidence remain immutable historical evidence but are stale for implementation readiness. Retain one neutral guarded-owner enumeration and source-location engine consumed through category adapters. Remove duplicate recursive enumeration, site inventory, and owner-matrix mechanics from launcher boundary and durability controls; category controls retain their semantic corpora, authentication, and diagnostics but derive callers, sites, and the sole-owner matrix from neutral mechanics.

WK-2361 D10 acceptance.criteria[1] | The neutral registry names, for every guarded class, the exact posture or boundary, sole semantic owner, sole code or translation owner where applicable, production discovery rule, stable diagnostic identity, and exact owner-produced proof or classification reference. It validates only mechanical registry facts: reference identity and grammar, location, current content digest, unique binding, contradiction, and the presence/currentness of the owner-produced classification or proof identity. It never revalidates authority-carrier content or schema, interprets owner classifications, decides policy, grants waivers, selects recovery, authenticates a carrier, or converts lifecycle state into local refusal authority.

WK-2361 D10 acceptance.criteria[2] | WK-2359 remains the sole owner of public refusal dispositions, envelopes, translations, and their behavioral proofs. WK-2382 remains the sole owner of asynchronous settlement, teardown precedence, cache retryability, process fail-stop dispositions, and their witnesses. WK-2357 owns durable publication and liveness generally. Current successor boundaries must also be preserved: WK-2391 owns coordination-preflight fact-family and authenticated-projection boundaries; WK-2405 owns findings-only lifecycle and immutable review-target semantics; WK-2428 owns same-call recovery predicate conformance; WK-2258 owns launcher common-proof receipt durable publication and restart-safe exact selection; and WK-2257 owns only common-proof resolver construction and wiki-MCP injection. Those successors do not expand the catch/code semantic-owner set, which remains closed to WK-2359 public-boundary entries and WK-2382 asynchronous entries.

WK-2361 D10 acceptance.criteria[3] | WK-2361 implementation depends on completed WK-2357, WK-2359, WK-2382, WK-2391, WK-2405, WK-2428, WK-2258, and WK-2257. Before implementation dispatch, freeze the exact current-main identity plus exact consumed leaf identities and SHA-256 digests for the WK-2359 exception/refusal corpora, runtime-code registry, translator carrier, and witnesses; the WK-2382 asynchronous census and witnesses; the WK-2391 preflight projection/authentication seams; the WK-2405 findings-target seams; the WK-2428 recovery predicate carrier; the WK-2258 receipt-store publication/selection carrier and witnesses; and the WK-2257 resolver/injection carrier and witnesses. Bind the provenance chain from original owner contracts and controlled carriers through every successor/remediation commit that changed a consumed path, including current-main digests and exact file-level `node --test <path>` selectors. Missing, moved, or ambiguous owners, artifacts, digests, successors, or selectors block readiness.

WK-2361 D10 acceptance.criteria[4] | Re-derive the audit's complete production populations, treating the reported 1,210 non-propagating catches and 771 statically resolvable code-shaped literals only as historical observations. The closed population is every Git-tracked `.mjs` file under `packages/*/src/**`, `packages/*/lib/**`, and `tools/**`; exclude top-level `tests/**`, package `test/**` or `tests/**`, fixture directories, `node_modules`, `.agent-runs`, caches, ignored/generated outputs, and canonical `docs/` or `wiki/`. Catch membership is every lexically parsed `catch` clause in the closed file set whose handler does not unconditionally rethrow the caught value at entry; code-literal membership is every string literal or closed string-enum member matching the repository runtime/refusal code grammar and used by a throw, rejection, error construction, public refusal/result construction, code comparison, or registered code collection. Parse failure, unreadable included source, ambiguous syntax classification, or an unaccounted generated-source marker is a mechanical census defect. Source identity is repository path plus syntactic ordinal and normalized construct kind; members...

WK-2361 D10 acceptance.criteria[5] | There is no anonymous legacy allowlist or permanent grandfathering. A confirmed-defect fact remains owned by its semantic corpus and carries exact source identity, semantic owner, remediation WK, falsifying test, and an independently bounded expiry or finite repository milestone. The engine validates the binding's shape and reports current lifecycle and sunset observations; only an authenticated CCE or other accepted deciding-authority result may grant, deny, or expire a waiver or make a non-mechanical readiness decision.

WK-2361 D10 acceptance.criteria[6] | An empty or unbound catch, log-and-continue path, detached rejection, generic module error default, or code-shaped literal is not automatically defective or safe. Owner corpora determine semantic disposition. Proven-safe suppression carries an exact reference to its semantic owner's executed witness; WK-2361 resolves the exact owner commit, content digest, file-level test selector, and execution contract, executes and freshness-checks that reference, and reports missing or stale evidence without redefining the proof or assigning policy consequence.

WK-2361 D10 acceptance.criteria[7] | Internal typed errors do not need runtime-blocker registration merely because they exist. The engine mechanically proves every registered path crossing an authority boundary reaches exactly one declared translator and reports raw builtin errors, platform codes, or locally invented public codes that escape. WK-2359 or WK-2382 remains the owner of the referenced semantic proof and any resulting policy decision.

WK-2361 D10 acceptance.criteria[8] | Preserve deny-by-default only for mechanical registry integrity: unparseable identities, duplicate bindings, contradictory owners, stale source locations, copied mechanical owner entries, missing or digest-mismatched owner-produced classification/proof references, census parse failures, and mechanically proven public-boundary escapes fail closed. Authority-carrier authentication and semantic classification remain with their current boundary owners; the neutral registry reports their exact owner-produced classification identities without revalidating carrier content. New callers, catches, code literals, missing semantic proofs, defect facts, and sunset observations are bounded evidence and do not produce a local nonzero readiness veto unless an exact authenticated deciding-authority result classifies that gate.

WK-2361 D10 acceptance.criteria[9] | All D4-D7 reviews, direct-main notes, redteam, and blueteam results remain immutable historical evidence and do not qualify D10. The operator-authorized restart produced D8 DRY run `wkdb_8271d4cdd0b9bb02`; its three findings were accepted and dispositioned once into D9. The complete D9 all-decisions run `wkdb_c92ac3bba1e3950a` reviewed all 51 accepted decisions at aggregate corpus digest `sha256:c844dde680f6e6dde3eacc4d06a929f48a93e5ef93f7b6300ac35b44a365e404` and returned one finding, D9-DEC-001, accepted and dispositioned once into D10: absence from the point-in-time WK-2359/WK-2382 corpora is bounded unresolved evidence, not an unconditional lint failure; only mechanically proven malformed owner evidence or boundary escape, or an exact authenticated deciding-authority gate, is nonzero. A new D10 controlled contract, proof plan, and obligation source must now be authored before one new design redteam with at most one exact blueteam challenge. No stale evidence, prior direct-main authorization, waiver, or CCE authority carries forward.

D10 incorporates the once-dispositioned operator-authorized D8 DRY review run wkdb_8271d4cdd0b9bb02 and complete D9 all-accepted-decisions review run wkdb_c92ac3bba1e3950a over all 51 accepted decisions at corpus digest sha256:c844dde680f6e6dde3eacc4d06a929f48a93e5ef93f7b6300ac35b44a365e404. Historical D4-D7 evidence does not qualify D10.

WK-2361 produces and validates mechanical ownership evidence only. Unresolved sites, defect facts, proof observations, lifecycle observations, waivers, recovery, and non-mechanical readiness remain inputs or outcomes of authenticated deciding authorities and are not locally authorized by this carrier.

D10 binds the current owner and successor chain: WK-2357, WK-2359, WK-2382, WK-2391, WK-2405, WK-2428, WK-2258, and WK-2257. WK-2258 owns common-proof durable publication/selection; WK-2257 owns resolver construction/wiki-MCP injection only. Current-main consumed paths require exact successor/remediation provenance.

WK-2361 D10 acceptance.criteria[10] | Add a repository lint rule that fails on mechanically proven production legacy raw throws or rejected promises crossing a public boundary; malformed registered public envelopes or translator bindings; route-local public refusal builders mechanically proven to bypass the declared owner; malformed registry/census state; prohibited bypass mechanisms; and an exact authenticated deciding-authority gate. A public emission or code-shaped identity absent from the point-in-time WK-2359/WK-2382 corpora is emitted as complete source-located unresolved evidence and does not itself make lint nonzero. Each site must resolve to a registered public translation, an explicitly private typed cause with one declared boundary translator, a proven-safe suppression carrying an exact owner witness, or bounded unresolved evidence. Anonymous allowlists, filename exemptions, inline disables, and fallback/graceful-degradation comments cannot bypass mechanical checks; internal typed errors proven not to cross a public boundary remain allowed.

The prior D7 redteam/blueteam remains immutable historical evidence only. The operator-authorized restart permits one new D10 design redteam after D10 contract/proof/obligation authoring and at most one exact blueteam challenge if findings are returned; no prior finding or waiver is carried forward.

residue.text: Exact authenticated CCE or accepted deciding-authority result identities for non-mechanical gates are not bound. WK-2361 validates only registry references and consumes owner-produced classifications; it cannot authenticate carrier content, synthesize a deciding result, grant a waiver, or turn unresolved evidence into a local veto.

Exact planned per-criterion/per-slice proof obligations are authored through the canonical obligation-coverage source. Delivered runtime test results, candidate-specific provider evidence, and post-delivery coverage remain deferred to the implementation slices and are not claimed pre-dispatch.

D10 DRY and complete all-decisions reviews are dispositioned. The D10 controlled contract, proof plan, obligation source, and blocked implementation slices are being synchronized against current main; one operator-authorized D10 design redteam remains required before implementation, with at most one exact blueteam challenge if it returns findings.

WK-2405 owns current findings-only lifecycle and immutable review-target semantics but its canonical status is active and closure is empty. D10 binds its current controlled carrier and committed current-main path identities as provisional owner evidence; WK-2361 implementation remains blocked until WK-2405 reaches canonical completion or an accepted successor contract explicitly replaces that dependency.
